# Maple: a 6-sided trunk and a round crown of three jittered icospheres; the whole tree sways about
# its foot (rigid, +-2 degrees, a smooth 4 s loop). Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.6 --location 0 0 0.8
material new Bark --base-color 0.286 0.302 0.494
add mesh ico-sphere --name CrownA --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.0 --location 0 0 2.2
material new Leaves --base-color 0.949 0.827 0.671
add mesh ico-sphere --name CrownB --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.72 --location 0.62 0.2 1.85
material assign Leaves
add mesh ico-sphere --name CrownC --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.66 --location -0.5 -0.3 2.75
material assign Leaves
select CrownA CrownB CrownC
active CrownA
join
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 4
mode object
select Trunk CrownA
active Trunk
join
rename Trunk Maple
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
shade flat
fps 24
frame range 0 96
select Maple
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 0
set rotation 2 1.5 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 24
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 48
set rotation -2 -1.5 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 72
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 96
frame set 0
export maple.glb --bake-animations
